data.group: Daemon Prince of Slaanesh with Wings
data.summary: Whenever this model finishes a **Charge move**, pick one enemy unit it is in **Engagement Range** of and roll a D6 for every wound it has left. Each 4+ inflicts 1 **mortal wound** on that unit, up to a limit of 6 mortal wounds.
